description: The bar chart illustrates the classification accuracy percentages of different models on novel real-world classification tasks in CLUES-Real. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 40% to 65%, while the horizontal axis lists the models compared. The models include RoBERTa without experience, ExEnt, LaSQuE (mean), LaSQuE, LaSQuE (syn2real), and LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum). The accuracy of RoBERTa without experience is approximately 45%, ExEnt is around 55%, LaSQuE (mean) is close to 50%, LaSQuE is slightly above 50%, LaSQuE (syn2real) is about 60%, and LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum) has the highest accuracy, nearing 65%. The bars are color-coded and arranged in ascending order of accuracy from left to right.
